items.stem: An automation sometimes writes blank values into the CRM even though the form was filled in. What is the most likely cause?

options.text: The fields were not mapped correctly between steps, so data landed in the wrong or empty fields
options.rationale: Correct: incorrect data mapping between trigger and action is the common cause of blank or misplaced values.

options.text: The CRM deletes data at random
options.rationale: CRMs do not randomly blank fields; mapping is the issue.
Appearance has no effect on data mapping.
Automations move text fine when fields are mapped correctly.

items.explanation: Correct: incorrect data mapping between trigger and action is the common cause of blank or misplaced values.

items.stem: Which TWO steps make an automation dependable before you rely on it in production? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Testing the flow end to end with representative sample data
options.rationale: Correct: testing with real-shaped data surfaces mapping and logic errors early.

options.text: Adding error handling or a fallback for failed steps
options.rationale: Correct: error handling keeps a run from failing silently.

options.text: Running it only once and assuming it always works
options.rationale: A single run does not prove reliability across cases.

options.text: Hiding the automation so no one can see it

items.explanation: Correct: testing with real-shaped data surfaces mapping and logic errors early.

items.stem: A team wants high-value leads routed to a sales channel and everyone else to a nurture list, in one automation. What feature fits?

options.text: A filter or path that branches on the lead's value
options.rationale: Correct: paths/filters route records down different branches based on a condition.
Separate accounts do not provide conditional routing within a flow.
That ignores the routing requirement entirely.
Disabling the trigger stops the automation rather than routing it.

items.explanation: Correct: paths/filters route records down different branches based on a condition.
